name: semantic_dread_architecture
label: The Semantic Architecture of Dread
godotFeature: Dynamic Node3D instantiation and ShaderMaterial manipulation driven by GDScript
poeticVision: The player will feel a profound, personal betrayal from the environment itself. As Lyra loses pieces of herself, the world around her doesn't just decay; it twists and warps into a physical manifestation of her deepest fears or unfulfilled longings, sculpted by the very memories she's forgotten. Every corner turned is a confrontation with a lost part of her soul, now weaponized against her by the Silence, forcing a desperate struggle through a landscape of her own grief and terror.
usage: Attach this script to a Node in your main scene (or as a global autoload). Set the 'Environment Root' export variable to a Node3D that represents the main environment where changes should occur. Create placeholder PackedScene and ShaderMaterial resources as specified in the export variables and assign them. When 'lose_memory()' or 'target_memory()' is called with a memory ID, the system will look up its associated semantic tags and trigger corresponding environmental effects (instantiating scenes or applying shaders to environment meshes).

parameters.name: environment_root
parameters.description: The root Node3D of the environment where dynamic changes (instantiation, shader application) will take place.

parameters.name: claustrophobic_tunnel_scene
parameters.description: A PackedScene resource to be instantiated as an environmental module when a memory with relevant semantic tags is lost or targeted. Create a simple scene (e.g., a BoxMesh) at this path for testing.

parameters.name: dissolving_shader_material
parameters.description: A ShaderMaterial resource to be applied to environment meshes when a memory with relevant semantic tags is lost or targeted. Create a ShaderMaterial resource and assign the 'dissolving_memory.gdshader' to it.

verdict: The very fabric of reality unravels into a mirror of Lyra's forgotten self, turning every step into a desperate dance with the ghosts of her own identity.
impact: The player will experience a deeply personal and unsettling transformation of the game world, where their own forgotten self becomes the very architecture of their dread, making every environmental challenge a confrontation with their dissolving identity. This elevates the stakes beyond mere physical survival to a profound psychological struggle, ensuring that the environment itself is a constant, evolving antagonist.
